narrative:

The second most influential factor was your lower-middle family-income bracket, which modestly pushed toward passing, so it worked in your favor. The third was your first-year class-rank decile: decile 3 versus an accepted average of about 6.00, and this also pushed toward failure. Your LSAT and undergraduate GPA were below accepted averages, but they were not the leading drivers.

Next, ask admissions whether you can appeal or discuss the decision, and provide any context the file does not show. Ask what evidence would support conditional admission or a delayed start. Strengthen your record where possible, especially third-year academic performance, and seek bar-readiness advising before reapplying.
